hypotheses.hypothesis: OOMP improves source-grounded historical retrieval outside the latest-eight window.
Temporal governance reduces current versus historical evidence confusion.
hypotheses.causal_limitation: No isolated temporal-filter switch; full versus flat also differs in other features and packing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph expansion improves supported multi-hop retrieval within actual depth limits.
Canonical consolidation reduces redundant evidence packing.
hypotheses.causal_limitation: No faithful consolidation-off production switch; canonical reuse can be inspected but causal gain remains inconclusive.
